# Data Integrity Checklist: Attribution Foundation

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of EDA-001 inventory, conditional fields, canonical row edits, and non-vacuous validation requirements.
**Created**: 2026-09-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Scope**: Standard-depth requirements review for the planning/PR reviewer; implementation behavior is not evaluated here.

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by `/speckit-checklist data-integrity` using the workflow domain prompt.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means requirements quality was reviewed and satisfied; it does not mean implementation is complete. All generated items remain unchecked.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does the specification define exactly 38 row objects in a closed `entries` root, with no missing or extra root fields? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002–FR-003; Ledger contract §Closed shape]
- [ ] CHK002 Is exact membership in the independent frozen pinned path inventory required in addition to a row count, including rejection of a substituted path at the same count? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007; Ledger contract §Frozen membership and ownership]
- [ ] CHK003 Are duplicate, missing, extra, unordered, and misbucketed upstream paths explicitly covered even when zero rows are landed? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007–FR-008; US2 acceptance scenario 2]
- [ ] CHK004 Are all required row fields, exact types, allowed disposition values, and unknown-field rejection specified before landed-row validation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003–FR-004, FR-008; Ledger contract §Closed shape]

## Conditional Field Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Are ABSORB/NEW requirements explicit about non-null destinations, planned/landed status, and absence of ignore_reason? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004; Ledger contract §Closed shape]
- [ ] CHK006 Are IGNORE requirements explicit about null destination, absent status, and a substantive reason, with deterministic rejection of empty or whitespace-only prose distinguished from reviewer evaluation of its explanation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004; Ledger contract §Closed shape]
- [ ] CHK007 Are substantive not_ported strings required for exactly ask-matt, wayfinder, and triage, with null required everywhere else and PARTIAL excluded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006; Ledger contract §Closed shape]
- [ ] CHK008 Is ownership defined by an independent exact path-to-owner mapping, including the 14 IGNORE owners and EDA-011 exclusion, without implying Git authorship? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005; Data model §Frozen inventory and owner evidence]
- [ ] CHK009 Are transitive source objects closed to six required string fields, and are empty, duplicate, malformed, or incorrect required pr sources explicitly addressed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, FR-015–FR-016; Ledger contract §Slice-2 pr source]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Are the empty slice-1 arrays and the exactly one pinned slice-2 pr source consistent across the specification, data model, ledger contract, and plan? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014–FR-016; Data model §Transitive source; Plan §Split decision and dependency boundary]
- [ ] CHK011 Are bucket values and the 18/7/4/9 totals specified as corroboration of exact path equality rather than its replacement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007; Ledger contract §Frozen membership and ownership]
- [ ] CHK012 Is frozen roadmap disposition/ownership evidence independent from the mutable ledger, with missing or ambiguous path/name joins rejected? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, FR-007; Data model §Frozen inventory and owner evidence; Plan §Phase 1 step 1]

## Stable Ordering and Formatting

- [ ] CHK013 Is lexicographic ordering by full upstream_path specified alongside fixed root, row, and transitive-object key orders? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002; Ledger contract §Canonical bytes]
- [ ] CHK014 Are UTF-8 without BOM, LF, two-space indentation, one final newline, no trailing spaces, and original-byte canonical comparison documented with no input normalization? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002, FR-008; Ledger contract §Canonical bytes]
- [ ] CHK015 Do row-flip requirements preserve all other rows and ordinary text merges, exclude the generated merge driver, and acknowledge that stacked branches may require rebasing? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Reviewability Notes, Clarifications Session 2; Ledger contract §Canonical bytes]

## Acceptance Criteria and Non-vacuity

- [ ] CHK016 Is a valid zero-landed ledger distinguished from an empty inventory, with exact 38-row validation and explicit nonzero inventory/row counts before success? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-007, FR-012, SC-003; Ledger contract §Frozen membership and ownership]
- [ ] CHK017 Are positive synthetic landed Markdown, TOML, Python, and SKILL.md cases required independently of the zero-real-landed ledger, with a nonzero checked-file count for each? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012, SC-005; Credits contract §Required proof cases; Plan §Phase 1 step 7]
- [ ] CHK018 Are empty landed directories and selections containing only excluded files explicitly treated as failures, while synthetic authored destination files remain eligible? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, FR-012; Credits contract §File selection]

## Exception Coverage and Durable Evidence

- [ ] CHK019 Are invalid JSON, duplicate object keys, non-finite values, wrong types, contradictory conditional fields, and noncanonical bytes specified as failures with targeted file/row/field diagnostics rather than silent coercion or unrelated exceptions? [Edge Cases, Spec §FR-008, FR-012; Ledger contract §Closed shape and §Failure contract]
- [ ] CHK020 Are expected inventory, owner mapping, license bytes, and fixture cases kept independent from the authored artifacts under test, with no runtime reads of temporary feature specs? [Dependencies, Spec §FR-005, FR-007, FR-017; Data model §Fixture cases; Plan §Structure Decision]
